figures.finding: The Labour Act applies to all work by children, employed or not; the Minister may set up a system of individual permits to engage a child under fourteen for purposes such as artistic performances, each permit prescribing the conditions and a limited number of hours; whether that system has been established wasn't found.

value.permit: individual permit under a system the Minister of Labour may establish (s. 12(8)-(9))

figures.applies: Section 12 reaches 'all forms of work performed by children, whether or not the child is an employee', so a child writer or director is reached by the general rules; the permit is for 'such purposes as participation in artistic performances'.

sources.said: This section shall apply to all forms of work performed by children, whether or not the child is an employee.

the Minister may establish a system by which a person might obtain a permit to engage a child under the age of fourteen years for such purposes as participation in artistic performances. (9) The permits provided for in sub-section (8) shall be granted on an individual basis and shall prescribe the conditions and limited number of hours under which the employment is to be allowed.

sources.title: FAOLEX: Laws of South Sudan, Labour Act, 2017 (Act No. 64), s. 12(1)
sources.said: This section shall apply to all forms of work performed by children, whether or not the child is an employee. … the Minister may establish a system by which a person might obtain a permit to engage a child under the age of fourteen years for such purposes as participation in artistic performances. (9) The permits provided for in sub-section (8) shall be granted on an individual basis and shall prescribe the conditions and limited number of hours under which the employment is to be allowed.
